title: NATO allies issue Washington Summit Declaration describing Ukraine's path to membership as irreversible
body:
On 10 July 2024 NATO heads of state and government issued the Washington Summit Declaration. On Ukraine, the document said that allies support Ukraine's irreversible path to full Euro-Atlantic integration, including NATO membership. It stated that Ukraine's future is in NATO and noted growing interoperability and political integration between Ukraine and the alliance.

The declaration did not issue an invitation. Allies said they will invite Ukraine to join when they agree and when conditions are met. It described the summit decisions and ongoing work as a bridge to Ukraine's membership in NATO. Allies welcomed Ukraine's progress on democratic, economic and security reforms since the 2023 Vilnius Summit and pledged to continue supporting interoperability and further reforms. The text also backed Ukraine's right to choose its own security arrangements and future without outside interference.

NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg said that after the war Ukraine should have enough capability to deter Russian aggression, along with security guarantees. He said the best guarantee is Article 5 of the Washington Treaty, and that NATO's ultimate goal in working with Ukraine is membership. Ukrinform reported the declaration on 11 July 2024.
